test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Bliss
solution: The correct answer is '**Sorrow**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Bliss**' is '**Sorrow**'. • **Bliss**: perfect happiness. (परमानंद, चटम सुखा) • *Example: The first six months of marriage were sheer **bliss**.* • **Sorrow**: a feeling of great sadness because something bad has happened. [गहरी खिन्‍नता, दुख, उदासी (अप्रिय घटना के कारण)] • *Example: He expressed **sorrow** for having caused the accident.* **Correct Answer:__** *Sorrow.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Pleasure**: the feeling of being happy or satisfied. (प्रसन्‍नता या संतुष्टि) • **Ecstasy**: a feeling or state of great happiness. (आह्लाद और आनंद की भावना; हर्षोन्माद) • **Happiness**: the state of being happy. (प्रसन्‍नता, ख़ुशी) 22c:T9f2, The correct answer is '**Indelible**'.
